version.approval_notes:
The extension only runs on Cardmarket wants list pages and Shopping Wizard result pages (https://www.cardmarket.com/<lang>/Magic/Wants/...), which require a free Cardmarket account.

Wants lists: reads each entry's edit page with fetch() and saves changes by submitting the same edit form a user would submit manually, only after the user clicks Apply, Reset or Undo.

Optimizer (since 0.4.0): on a Shopping Wizard result page, 'Optimize incl. shipping' reads the offers of the sellers involved, computes the cheapest combination including shipping and adds it to the cart only after the user confirms. help.cardmarket.com is an optional permission, requested from the settings page, used only for Cardmarket's public shipping price table.

Third-party code: vendor/highs/highs.js and vendor/highs/highs.wasm are the unmodified build files of the npm package 'highs' 1.15.4 (MIT, https://www.npmjs.com/package/highs, source https://github.com/lovasoa/highs-js), a WebAssembly build of the HiGHS linear programming solver. They can be compared with node_modules/highs/build/ after 'npm install highs@1.15.4'. Everything else is plain, unminified JavaScript with no build step: https://github.com/AonyxCinerea/Want-Not-for-Cardmarket
